notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 is ready, thanks for your patience.
The list of changes is huge, the most important ones are

1) The combat system has been completely reworked. Now you have to press attack buttons instead of holding them. You could interrupt an attack by rolling (but only for a few frames at the beginning of the animation). You could control the direction of your attack without moving the camera.
2) Combat softlock system. Now Kaori scans an area in front of her and automatically rotates to possible targets.
3) A proper difficulty level system. If you want to try it with your old save file, please create an empty file easy.txt or hard.txt and put it into this folder: C:\Users\[your username]\AppData\LocalLow\Grim's Studio\Cursed Pantsu
4) Chinese and Japanese localization has been greatly improved thanks to Karei and AgeBdeR.
5) Mini-maps on almost every floor!
6) The mob spawn system was changed. Mobs do not spawn between floors, they spawn when you speak with Akari.
7) The camera movements are now sharper, and not "floaty" anymore.
8) The combat lock-on system has been reworked. It now sorts targets by their distance from the player.
9) Lots of new mannequin-type traps. They know some wrestling moves, be careful!
10) Bonus damage when attacking enemies from behind: 150%. Watch your positioning.
11) New behavior for mobs and bosses. Some mobs are now slower but can block your frontal attacks. Boss girls can sometimes dodge your attacks.
12) New mob type. It can't hurt you, but trust me, it can be very dangerous in some situations.
13) I removed all AI images and replaced them with handmade art.
14) VFX has been significantly improved. The fog is now thicker and much darker.
15) New traps. Some of the traps can now also hurt mobs.
16) Fixed the camera clipping bug. Along with many other minor bugs.
17) The game has been rebalanced. Kaori is faster and more agile, but some of her enemies are also more powerful. The platforming part of the game is now much easier.
18) Sound design improvements.

As for the defeat event DLC, it is also ready, waiting for moderation by Valve. Please wait for it or download it elsewhere.

notes.title: Version 1.1. New panties!
notes.notes:
Dear players, finally version 1.1. is ready. 

1) Camera targeting mode improvements. Now you don't target mobs behind walls anymore.
2) Idle animations for Kaori. Don't move for 20 seconds to see them.
3) Boss girls have been rebalanced, now they are more healthy but less dangerous.
4) Main menu input bug has been fixed. You can now navigate the menu using the D-pad buttons on your controller.
5) White censor clouds are now disabled by default. You can turn them on in the settings.
6) Sound design improvements, more sounds for mobs.
7) A new pair of panties has been added, you can find yellow panties on level 9. 
8) You can turn off post-processing effects in the settings.
9) You can change the text speed in the settings.
10) Levels 3, 5, 6 and 7 have been slightly rebalanced to make the game easier.

To everyone who sent bug reports or posted reviews, thank you!

notes.title: New update to fix magic skills
notes.notes:
Thanks to Sturmer I've found a serious bug in magic skills and quick items. Now it is fixed, and all cooldowns are functioning correctly.
Also, the bug with restoring health on the 7th level was fixed too.
 
The "black skirt" item on the 2nd level was changed to the "blue skirt" because it is too powerful.

notes.title: Important update. White clouds bug.
notes.notes:
I've found a terrible bug with clouds covering Kaori's intimate places!
If you put any file with the name "uncensor.txt" to C:\Users\-your username-\AppData\LocalLow\Grim's Studio\Cursed Pantsu\ then clouds will disappear. 
I am not sure how to fix it, just don't create this file.

As for other bugs, thanks to players who played the release build I've fixed:
1) The maid boss bug. When you lose to her, the key is no more in your inventory, you can't open the door.
2) Bug with dead mobs who do not disappear. 

Also, there are some other important improvements in the v. 1.03:
1) Easy mode. You can start a new game with increased stats.
2) Ultra-wide 21/9 monitor support. 
3) Additional boxes with cloth on each level.
4) Additional experience points for strong mobs.
5) New Akari checkpoint on the third level.
6) Additional UI buttons in the game menu to make navigation easier.
7) Standard kicks are slower now.

notes.title: One month to release!
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that 80% of the game is finished. The release is planned for March 7th, just before Women's Day. Buy Cursed Pantsu for your girlfriend!

Main updates:
1) Boss girls added. You can see them in the screenshot.
2) I've added the stamina mechanic to make the game more challenging. Rolls are especially expensive.
3) The cloth damage system has been changed. Damaged cloth now reduces the stat bonus, but increases the EXP bonus modifier. Playing half-naked is risky, but rewarding.
4) New enemies, traps and platforming elements added.

notes.title: Demo version for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
The game will participate in the Steam Next Fest. The demo version is (probably, if you see the green button) available right now!
The current demo version is 0.11. It includes two levels. Tutorial and all game's main features are implemented in it.
If you had played the 0.1 version, you've already seen all demo content. But the quality of the game was improved from back then.
